parameters.description_en: The state of the version. Valid values: DRAFT: The version is in the draft state. EFFECTIVE: The version is effective. PUBLISHING: The version is being published. INEFFECTIVE: The version has expired. FAILED: The version has not taken effect.
parameters.description_zh:
版本状态。
